statement: Attacking a floating eye in melee below character level 10 can leave the character paralysed until something else kills it.

evidence.note: Died to a floating eye at depth 3, character level 8, after walking into it.

confidence.rests_on: One death, with the game's own cause of death and the messages before it.
alternatives_ruled_out: Starvation: the character was fed at the time.
Another monster: no other monster was visible in the ten turns before.
